Ah-, run past, believe my heart
Yes, the future always shines for you
You can do it, because you believe
Ah-,  now, accept the legendary light, and fly off
A bundle of lights comes out of the fog, come on, the warm thoughts in this breast!
You take that sword in your hand and open those gates to grasp tomorrow
How much sadness must you pass through, to be allowed to dream?
Yes, just the number of thoughts, people shine again
The light is always with you
Ah-, flap your legendary wings, and fly away
Ah-, wish on a shooting star, that you might grasp even fate in these hands!
You look up at the darkness, to change tomorrow, now begin to move
Whenever you see distant lamp lights, destruction will come again
Continue to the location of light
Surely a wonderful comedy performance of life is coming on
Now, many things become one in your heart
Then, at the end of the long journey,
No matter how far away tomorrow is
Dreaming of that place, now just believe
AH-, people lose the light, frozen hearts
In the direction the heart points, advance without hesitating
AH-, violently blowing wind, continue endlessly
AH-, o person who walks off, be burdened with fate
One by one, connect their hearts
The voice that leads thousands of soldiers is Feeling
As if to illuminate lives one by one
Look up, in this sky, countless stars are shining
Each tomorrow aims at a shining place
In the stillness, held in his lap
A certain person has a still-unreliable friend
Now I'm living on this irreplaceable earth
Days filled with joy are, after all,
Continue to search for a new road to a future not yet seen
Strained memories and faint noise, the seasons pass
